# Indeed for Employers

> > Indeed's employer platform providing hiring solutions including Sponsored Jobs, Smart Sourcing, ATS integration, and recruiting tools for remote and hybrid workforce management.

Indeed for Employers offers comprehensive resources for companies to post jobs, manage applicants, and optimize their hiring process. The platform includes guides on remote job postings, employer products like Featured Employer and Company Pages, and integration with applicant tracking systems.

## Key Topics

- Sponsored Jobs
- Indeed Smart Sourcing
- ATS (Applicant Tracking System)
- Remote Job Postings
- Hybrid Remote Work
- Mobile Recruiting
- Featured Employer
- Company Pages
- Pay-per-Performance Pricing
- Job Posting Optimization
- Virtual Hiring
- Job Description Generator
- Recruiting Solutions
- Hiring Insights

## Support & FAQs

- [Indeed Employer Frequently Asked Questions](https://indeed.com/hire/resources/howtohub/faq): Comprehensive FAQ covering Indeed's employer products, ATS integration & hiring
- [Frequently Asked Questions About Indeed's Employer Products](https://ca.indeed.com/hire/faq): FAQ on Indeed pricing, Sponsored Jobs, Smart Sourcing & employer products

## Job Posting Guides

- [Remote Job Postings on Indeed: A Guide for Employers](https://indeed.com/hire/resources/howtohub/remote-job-postings): Guide for employers on creating and optimizing remote job postings on Indeed
